question: Sampling interval of site-level PV data
Is power(W) AC or DC?
finding: AC active power. Inverter total = sum of three AC phase active powers (mean |diff| 0.0000 W); site level matches inverter 15-min mean (r=0.98290). No DC current exists in the dataset, so DC power is not derivable.

question: Instantaneous or aggregated?
finding: Interval-aggregated: power(W) behaves as a 15-minute mean, generation(kWh) as the matching interval energy
evidence_source: SQ1.csv generation(kWh) vs power(W) empirical comparison

question: Does the distribution show inverter clipping?
finding: max 27,735 W = 100.5% of the 27.6 kW rating; 282 rows within 2% of max — no dense ceiling, no strong clipping evidence
evidence_source: SQ1.csv power(W) distribution vs TTL rating

question: SQ1 azimuth
finding: TTL says 0deg; pipeline uses 180°. Irrelevant at zero tilt but not matching

question: SQ1 location and altitude
finding: TTL: lat 22.33, lon 114.18, altitude 94.0 m. Pipeline: 22.3363, 114.2634, 30 m (README campus centroid). Discrepancy in longitude and altitude
evidence_source: TTL vs README vs pipeline constants

question: Irradiance measurement plane
finding: Not documented. Weather-tower installation implies global horizontal, but no source states it. Inert for SQ1 (tilt=0, so GHI==POA)
evidence_source: Dataset README; TTL has no weather-station entry

question: Is SQ1 documented as served by this weather station?
finding: No. The weather station is absent from the Brick model and no PV-to-station mapping is documented. One station serves 60 stations; pairing is an unavoidable assumption
evidence_source: README; TTL contains no weather-station entity

question: Timezone of raw and intermediate timestamps
finding: All files naive (no offset). Hong Kong local time assumed; HK has no DST since 1979 so +8 is unambiguous if the assumption holds
evidence_source: Header inspection of raw and derived CSVs

question: Sampling intervals
finding: PV site level 0 days 00:15:00 (README says 5 min — data wins); inverter level 5 min; meteorological 0 days 00:01:00. Preprocessing resamples all to 15 min by mean

question: Meteorological variables available
finding: Seven folders. Used: Irradiance, Temperature. Available and unused: Rainfall, Relative Humidity, Sea Level Pressure, Visibility, Wind

question: Is a future-prediction horizon specified anywhere?
finding: No. No tutor, brief, objective or protocol document states a lead time. The implemented script performs same-time estimation with no lag or shift
evidence_source: Full-text search of repository materials and the current script
